extra:
## This work (Р-251, third English work of the series)

Source: the English original `gallilee-springs-en` (text layer; the pages carry no printed numbers, so page = physical page; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show gallilee-springs-en <page>`; page image `pages.py image gallilee-springs-en <page> --physical`; physical 1 = cover (picture only), physical 2 = introduction «How to use this mini-scenario» and credits). The book spells the title «Gallilee» on the file and «Galilee Springs» in the text — the Russian form is one for both (choose by the text: «Галили-Спрингс»), the other spelling in `aliases`. Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184). New terms of this book — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian); the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.

- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice incl. the author's «how to use» notes, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards if any, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (the book gives very few stats: take stats only as printed, Р-25; suggested investigators — the three fathers — are characters of the scenario with role `pregen` only if the book describes them as such, else as suggestions inside the scenario), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared record, Grep `kb/creatures` first; a unique being — book record), organizations (the «Coordinators» / the government program — an `organization` book record if the book describes it), items and clues (the fungus spores …), handouts if any (text as printed, our translation), places (Galilee Springs is a fictional California town — a book place, its places with `part_of`). Do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`.
- Book-scoped ids `gallilee-springs-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/gallilee-springs-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241): the only picture is the cover (physical 1) — decide whether it is atmosphere or the scenario picture; mapping `checks/20261116-gallilee/art.json` if any, apply proposals yourself; atmosphere → `checks/20261116-gallilee/atmosphere.json`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; no two records with the same `name.ru`; terms inside text agree with record names.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books gallilee-springs-en --out checks/20261116-gallilee/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books gallilee-springs-en --out checks/20261116-gallilee/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/gallilee-springs-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261116-gallilee/gallilee.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), misprints, and the term list (English → Russian).
